scope: Deterministic retention and purge control for unclaimed E2EE attachment ciphertext

controls.candidate_policy: ready_client_encrypted + exact E2EE MIME/purpose + unclaimed by every message + retention elapsed
controls.receipt: SHA256 canonical purge fact; no plaintext, key or user PII

findings.finding: A completed E2EE attachment upload that lost the device-set race before message commit had no deterministic deletion boundary.
findings.resolution: Unclaimed ciphertext now becomes eligible only after a 24-hour retry window and only through an explicit bounded purge run whose default is dry-run.

findings.finding: A purge racing a message claim could remove ciphertext after the message acquired its reference.
findings.resolution: Every candidate is rechecked under a BEGIN IMMEDIATE write lock and any message reference excludes deletion.

findings.finding: Filesystem failure could otherwise leave the database claiming a successful purge.
findings.resolution: Storage deletion failure rolls back the receipt and database deletion so the same object remains retryable.

capacity.reason: Goal reports usageLimited; completed one bounded local packet without a worker
